about_the_game:
Don't Wake Up My Dream is a lighthearted puzzle-adventure game that tells the story of a dreamy dog on a whimsical journey to meet someone very special.

Throughout this bumpy journey, players will dive into the dog’s dreams and guide him through wildly imaginative dreamscapes, each with its own quirky style and surprising logic. Inside these dreams, you'll witness the dog’s unexpected “inner dramas” — from sweet tales of love to laugh-out-loud slices of daily life. Every chapter holds a unique little mystery, just waiting to be solved.

With hand-drawn visuals full of humor, warmth, and heart, the game is lovingly crafted by a solo developer to offer a soothing yet playful experience.

This is a story about love, life, and laughter — and a dog’s fantastical journey in pursuit of a dream.
